entries.spell_riventricleave_summary: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.
entries.spell_riventricleave_tooltip:
Riven dashes forward, dealing @FirstSlashDamage@ physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect:

Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing @FirstSlashDamage@ physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.
entries.spell_riventricleave_tooltipextendedbelo:
Only the last use of this Ability can cross terrain.
Riven targets the unit your cursor is on, or dashes forward if there is no target.
entries.spell_rivenmartyr_summary: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.
entries.spell_rivenmartyr_tooltip: Riven's sword emits a burst of runic energy, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> for @StunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_rivenfeint_summary: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.
entries.spell_rivenfeint_tooltip: Riven quickly dashes and gains <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> for 1.5 seconds.
entries.spell_rivenpassive_tooltip: Using an Ability grants Riven a charge for 6 seconds (max @Charges@). Her Attacks spend a charge to deal an additional <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
entries.spell_rivenpassive_summary: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.
entries.spell_rivenpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_RivenPassive_Tooltip}}

The bonus damage can critically strike.
Deals @MonsterBonusDamage@ bonus damage to monsters.
entries.spell_rivenfengshuiengine_summary: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.
entries.spell_rivenfengshuiengine_tooltip:
Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her @BonusAD@ Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for @Duration@ seconds. While active, she can Recast.

Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between @MinDamage@ and @MaxDamage@ physical damage, based on their missing Health.
entries.spell_jarvanivmartialcadence_summary: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.
entries.spell_jarvanivmartialcadence_tooltip: Jarvan's Attacks deal an additional <physicalDamage>@TooltipCurrentHealthDamage*100@% current Health physical damage</physicalDamage>. This effect has a @TooltipCooldown@ second Cooldown per target.
entries.spell_jarvanivmartialcadence_tooltipexte:
{{ Spell_JarvanIVMartialCadence_Tooltip }}

Deals a minimum of 20 and a maximum of 400 damage to non-champions.
entries.spell_jarvanivdragonstrike_summary: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.
entries.spell_jarvanivdragonstrike_tooltip:
Jarvan extends his lance, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and removing @BaseARShred*100@% Armor for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.

If the lance connects with {{Spell_JarvanIVDemacianStandard_Name}}, Jarvan will pull himself to it, Knocking Up those in his path for 0.75 seconds.
entries.spell_jarvanivcataclysm_summary: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.
entries.spell_jarvanivcataclysm_tooltip:
Jarvan heroically leaps to an enemy Champion, dealing @DamageCalc@ physical damage to them and surrounding enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for @WallDuration@ seconds.

Jarvan can Recast to collapse the terrain.
entries.spell_jarvanivgoldenaegis_summary: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.
entries.spell_jarvanivgoldenaegis_tooltip: Jarvan summons an aegis, <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by @BaseSlowAmount*100@% for @Effect5Amount@ seconds and granting him a <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield>, increased by <shield>@BonusShield@</shield> for each enemy champion hit.
entries.spell_jarvanivdemacianstandard_summary: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.
entries.spell_jarvanivdemacianstandard_tooltip:
Passive: Jarvan gains @PermanentAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Jarvan throws a standard into the ground, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and granting allies near the standard @BaseAuraAS*100@% Attack Speed for @Effect4Amount@ seconds.
entries.game_character_passivetooltip_malphite: Malphite grants himself <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> after not taking damage for @PassiveCooldown@ seconds.
entries.game_character_passivedescription_malphi: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
entries.spell_obduracy_summary: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
entries.spell_obduracy_tooltip:
Passive: Malphite gains @BonusArmorPassive*100@% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%@f1@). This effect is increased to @BonusArmorPassive*300@% (%i:scaleArmor%@f2@) while Granite Shield is active.

Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional @TotalBonusDamage@ physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals @ThunderclapSplash@ physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next @ThunderclapBuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_ufslash_summary: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
entries.spell_ufslash_tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite <status>Knocks Up</status> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_seismicshard_summary: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
entries.spell_seismicshard_tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>@QDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SpeedSteal@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Malphite also steals the amount <status>Slowed</status>, gaining it as <speed>Move Speed</speed> for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_landslide_summary: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
entries.spell_landslide_tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing <magicDamage>@EDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by @ASReduction@%</attackSpeed> for @Duration@ seconds.
